names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 19 iunie, «Sfântul Apostol Iuda, ruda Domnului»; the line's «ruda Domnului» is the kinship, not part of the name.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Ιουνίου, «Άγιος Ιούδας ο Απόστολος», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 19. јун ст. ст., „Свети апостол Јуда“ — Свети is not a rank and апостол is the rank, which `types` already carries; both come off and the bare forename is left, which is all the heading gives. **The by-names are in the body and are not built onto the form**: the entry says he is called „Јуда Јаковљев“ after his more notable brother, and also Левијем and Тадејем, and the «brother of the Lord» of the display name is not in this heading at all. `foldchk.py` returns NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM for «Јуда», so there is no fold — which is worth having measured, the corpus keeping a `thaddeus-apostle-of-the-seventy` whom this very entry exists to tell him apart from.

Read out of the name link behind his place in days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 19 июня ст. ст., «Иуда Иаковлев (Леввей, Фаддей), апостол из 12-ти», with the words of number and rank left off. The parenthetical second and third names are the calendar's own.

feast.note: The same menologion number this folder's three other venerated rows carry. His life page life1346 heads «Дни памяти: 19 июня , 30 июня (12 ап.)»; the 30 июня is the synaxis of the Twelve Apostles, a synaxis and not a second feast, and this folder renders on 19 июня ст. ст. only. life1346 was read and its account agrees with what this folder already carries — the descent from Joseph, the names Thaddaeus and Levvei, Edessa, the epistle, and the death about 80 in Armenia — so no paragraph was added and the four hymns are what this upgrade brings.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 июня ст. ст. — «Апостола Иуды , брата Господня (ок. 80).»

feast.note: doxologia.ro also names him in «Soborul Sfinților 12 Apostoli» on 30 iunie, the Synaxis of the Twelve Apostles, whose life calls him «Sfântul Apostol Iuda, fiul Sfântului Iosif logodnicul» (read 24 September 2026). One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 19 iunie — «Sfântul Apostol Iuda, ruda Domnului»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Ιούδας ο Απόστολος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It is the same apostle the folder's Romanian row keeps on 19 June: saint.gr's first authority, S. Eustratiades, has him the brother of Christ and of James the brother of God, children of Joseph by another marriage, which is the identification the folder's display name carries. The page itself warns that the data are confused with those of the Apostle Thaddaeus of 21 August and gives a second account, from Michael Galanos, making him one of the Twelve, son of Alphaeus and brother of James the Less; both are recorded in the life and neither is decided here. It gives no year. The page further reports, out of the Lavriotic codex I 78, a second Apostle Jude called the Zealot commemorated on this same day, who reposed in peace; that is a manuscript notice and not a line of the day's listing, and no folder is made for him. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 02.07.2026 (19. јун ст. ст.) — „Свети апостол Јуда“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. The Julian 19 June is the same menologion number this folder’s other venerated row or rows carry, so there is no second day and no §4 note is owed. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND STILL ABSENT. The folder holds no `dates` object, because neither doxologia nor saint.gr gave a year, and **this book gives none either** — no year for the preaching, none for the crucifixion near Ararat. Nothing is written. A GENEALOGY THE FOLDER HALF HELD, AND ONE NAME IN IT THAT IS NEW. doxologia had Joseph the carpenter and Salome «the daughter of Haggai, son of Barachiah and brother of Zacharias», and the four sons «James, Joses, Simon and Jude» out of Matthew. This book has the same four and spells the second „Јосију“, and its Salome is „ћерком Ангеја, сина Варахина Захаријана“ — the same three names in the same order, so **two books now agree on a genealogy the corpus had from one**. THE HUMILITY, AND A SECOND REASON FOR IT. The folder already explains why he calls himself „брат Јаковљев“ and not the brother of the Lord: humility, and that at the beginning he had sinned in ignorance and unbelief. This book adds the scene that makes it concrete — **when the aged Joseph before his death wished to give Jesus a share of the property along with his other children, all of them opposed it, Jude among them, and only James willingly divided a part off his own share and set it aside for Jesus.** Neither other book has it, and it is written into the life. The epistle’s opening is quoted with its reference, „Јуда слуга Исуса Христа, брат Јаковљев“ (Јд 1, 1). THE TWO THADDEUSES, AND THE „(в. “ INSTRUMENT NOT NEEDED. The entry says he is also called Levi and Thaddeus, and then distinguishes him: „има још један Тадеј, од Седамдесеторице апостола (в. 21. август), но овај Тадеј, или Јуда, био је један од великих апостола“. The standing instrument for a „(в. “ and a date is to read the Prologue’s own other day — and **here there is nothing to read it for**, because the entry itself says what the other day holds and says that the two are different men. `thaddeus-apostle-of-the-seventy` exists and **takes no row**: a man an entry exists to distinguish its subject *from* is not a relation. saint.gr’s own page already warned that the two are confused and the folder already records that warning. THE PREACHING, AND IT IS WIDER HERE THAN IN EITHER OTHER BOOK. Judea, Samaria, Galilee, Idumaea, Syria, Arabia, Mesopotamia and Armenia — eight regions, where saint.gr had Mesopotamia and Edessa and doxologia had «many countries». And at Edessa, „граду Авгаровом“, the city of Abgar, he completed the preaching of that other Thaddeus — **the one place this book brings the two men together, and it is a succession in a city and not a kinship**, so still no row. `ls saints | grep -i abgar` holds nobody. The end agrees with the folder: taken by the pagans in the parts about Ararat, crucified and killed with arrows. `types` UNTOUCHED: `apostle` and `martyr` are both there, апостол is the `apostle` and the arrows are the `martyr`. No `office`, no `locations` — eight regions in one clause are not a coordinate. **No rows at all.** `grep` finds no folder for James the brother of the Lord under any of `james-brother-of`, `james-the-just`, `james-of-jerusalem` or `james-the-less`; Joses, Simon, Joseph the carpenter, Salome, Haggai, Barachiah and Zacharias are named in the folder’s older prose already and no folder holds any of them as this entry means them. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse. THE DAY’S FOURTH ENTRY IS REFUSED FOR WANT OF A FOLDER. „Преподобни Јован отшелник“ — John the hermit, who struggled in the sixth century near Jerusalem, reached by his ascesis so high a degree of purity and power that the wild beasts obeyed him, and reposed in the Lord in deep old age in 586. **Two folders read like him and neither is he.** `john-the-hermit-of-crete` is kept by the Greek calendar on **7 October**, holds no dates, and is of Crete, not of the desert near Jerusalem; `john-of-jerusalem` has `office` «Patriarch of Jerusalem», which a hermit is not. `ls saints | grep -iE 'john-the-herm|john-the-anchor|john-of-jerus'` returns those two and nothing else. Ruling 3: named here, left out of every life on this day, and no folder from me — and the sixth century and the year 586 are written nowhere, because there is nothing to write them on.

hymns.text: Al lui Hristos frate şi mucenic tare, ştiindu-te pe tine, Sfinte Iuda, cu sfinţenie te lăudăm pe tine, cel ce ai călcat înşelăciunea şi credinţa ai păzit. Pentru aceasta astăzi preasfântă pomenirea ta prăznuind, dezlegare de păcate cu rugăciunile tale luăm.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Apostol Iuda, ruda Domnului.

english.text: Knowing thee to be the brother of Christ and a strong martyr, O holy Jude, we praise thee with holiness, who didst trample down deceit and keep the faith. Wherefore, keeping today thy most holy memory, by thy prayers we receive release from sins.

hymns.text: Χριστοῦ σὲ συγγενῆ, ὦ Ἰούδα εἰδότες, καὶ μάρτυρα στερρόν, ἱερῶς εὐφημοῦμεν, τὴν πλάνην πατήσαντα, καὶ τὴν πίστιν τηρήσαντα, ὅθεν σήμερον, τὴν παναγίαν σου μνήμην, ἑορτάζοντες, ἁμαρτημάτων τὴν λύσιν, εὐχαίς σου λαμβάνομεν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), ᾌχος α’, Τὸν τάφον σου Σωτήρ — the first of two apolytikia on the page of «Άγιος Ιούδας ο Απόστολος», and it names him and his kinship

english.text: Knowing thee, O Jude, to be a kinsman of Christ and a steadfast martyr, we praise thee sacredly, who didst trample down error and keep the faith; and therefore, keeping today thy all-holy memory, we receive by thy prayers the loosing of our sins.

hymns.text: Ἐκ ῥίζης εὐκλεοῦς, θεοδώρητον κλῆμα, ἀνέτειλας ἡμῖν, τοῦ Κυρίου αὐτόπτα, Ἀπόστολε θεάδελφε, τοῦ Χριστοῦ κῆρυξ πάνσοφε, τρέφων ἅπαντα, κόσμον καρποῖς σου τῶν λόγων, τὴν ὀρθόδοξον, πίστιν Κυρίου διδάσκων, ὡς μύστης τῆς χάριτος.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, ᾌχος α’, Χορὸς Ἀγγελικός — on the same page, and it calls him θεάδελφος, brother of God

english.text: Out of a glorious root thou didst rise for us, a branch given of God, eyewitness of the Lord, apostle and brother of God, all-wise herald of Christ, feeding the whole world with the fruits of thy words and teaching the Orthodox faith of the Lord as one initiated into grace.

hymns.text: Христова тя сродника, о Иудо, ведуще и мученика тверда,/ священно восхваляем, прелесть поправша и веру соблюдша./ Темже днесь всесвятую твою память празднующе,// грехов разрешение молитвами твоими приемлем.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 июня ст. ст. — «Тропарь апостола Иуды», глас 1. The first of two troparia the page prints for him, and proper to him: «о Иудо» in the vocative.

english.text: Knowing thee, O Jude, to be Christ's kinsman and a steadfast martyr, we praise thee in holy song, for thou didst tread down delusion and keep the faith. Therefore, keeping today thy all-holy memory, we receive by thy prayers the loosing of sins.

hymns.text: Чистоту душевную и житие непорочно стяжав,/ Пречистаго Света, нам приближшагося, быв по плоти брат и ученик,/ благочестия проповедник и языком учитель истинный,/ Иудо всехвальне,/ моли Христа Бога,/ да спасет души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 июня ст. ст. — «Ин тропарь апостола Иуды, брата Господня», глас 1. The page marks it «Ин тропарь», another troparion, and heads it for the brother of the Lord; proper to him — «Иудо всехвальне».

english.text: Having gained purity of soul and a blameless life, thou wast after the flesh the brother and the disciple of the Most Pure Light who drew near to us, a preacher of piety and a true teacher of the nations. O all-praised Jude, pray to Christ God that He may save our souls.

hymns.text: Твердым умом избран ученик ты явился еси/ и столп необорим Церкве Христовы,/ языком проповедал еси слово Христово,/ веровати глаголя во Едино Божество;/ от Негоже прославився, приял еси дар исцелений,/ целити недуги притекающих к тебе,// апостоле Иудо всехвальне.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 июня ст. ст. — «Кондак апостола Иуды», глас 2. Proper to him: «апостоле Иудо всехвальне» in the vocative.

english.text: By thy steadfast mind thou wast shown to be a chosen disciple and an unshaken pillar of the Church of Christ; thou didst preach the word of Christ to the nations, bidding them believe in one Godhead. Glorified by Him, thou didst receive the gift of healings, to heal the sicknesses of those who run to thee, O all-praised apostle Jude.

hymns.text: Павлу явлься собеседник, апостоле,/ с сим нам проповедь возвестил еси Божественный благодати,/ тайноглагольниче Иудо блаженне./ Сего ради вопием ти:/ не престай моляся о всех нас.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 июня ст. ст. — «Кондак апостола Иуды, брата Господня», глас 2. The page marks it «Ин кондак», another kontakion, and heads it for the brother of the Lord; proper to him — «тайноглагольниче Иудо блаженне».

english.text: Shown to be Paul's companion in speech, O apostle, with him thou didst declare to us the preaching of the divine grace, O blessed Jude, speaker of mysteries. Therefore we cry to thee: cease not to pray for us all.
